name: Swarna Parpati

sections.introduction: Swarna Parpati is an ayurvedic formulation that is prepared from the mixture of effective mineral and herbs. This formulation is formulated in powder form. This medicine is known to treat problems mainly related with respiratory and sexual health related diseases.
sections.ingredients:
Shuddha Parad – Purified Mercury 
 Shuddha Gandhaka – Purified Sulphur 
 Swarna Bhasma – Gold calx 

 Method of Preparation 

 Take the ingredients in its given quantity. Take parad and gandhaka up to 48 grams and swarna bhsama up to 12 grams. 
 Now first of all take parad and gold leaves and triturate well. 
 Triturate again for one day by adding lemon juice in it. 
 After one day wash the mixture with hot water. 
 Now add gandhaka in it and triturated the mixture till the kajjali is prepared. 
 Take that kajjali, add ghee smeared iron ladle, melt it and pour this mixture over banana leaf. 
 Keep this banana leaf over cow dung cake and press with another banana leaf. 
 Allow it to self-cool and after self-cooling, collect this in the air tight glass bottle. 

 Medicinal Properties 
 Swarna Parpati is a beneficial Ayurvedic formulation that is very helpful to keep the Vata, Pitta and Kapha doshas balanced, possessing antiseptic, antacid and aphrodisiac properties, acts as a nutritive tonic, strengthens the body and mind. 
 This Ayurvedic medicine is effective in GIT related problems. It is suitable to provide relief from pain in intestinal colic, useful in chronic dysentery, provides relief from abdominal cramps, helps to control loose motion and other symptoms. Also good to use in sprue providing relief from weakness and aids in rapid recovery and even beneficial in Ulcerative Colitis. It improves the digestion also and helps in reducing the ulcers in oral cavity caused in stomatitis. It is useful remedy for respiratory conditions as in chronic bronchial diseases, reduces inflammation and improves the breathing to normal tone and beneficial in asthma, dilates the airway passage and ease in breathing and also suitable in tuberculosis too. It acts as a natural aphrodisiac, which makes it very useful in oligospermia. It has property to improve the condition of the patient in case of General debility. Suitable in memory loss too.

 Reference – Bhaishajya Ratnavali Grahani Rogadhikara. 
 Introduction 
 Swarna Parpati is an ayurvedic formulation that is prepared from the mixture of effective mineral and herbs. This formulation is formulated in powder form. This medicine is known to treat problems mainly related with respiratory and sexual health related diseases. 
 Ingredients 
 
 Shuddha Parad – Purified Mercury 
 Shuddha Gandhaka – Purified Sulphur 
 Swarna Bhasma – Gold calx 
 
 Method of Preparation

 Now first of all take parad and gold leaves and triturate well. 
 Triturate again for one day by adding lemon juice in it.

 Take that kajjali, add ghee smeared iron ladle, melt it and pour this mixture over banana leaf. 
 Keep this banana leaf over cow dung cake and press with another banana leaf. 
 Allow it to self-cool and after self-cooling, collect this in the air tight glass bottle.

 Swarna Parpati is a beneficial Ayurvedic formulation that is very helpful to keep the Vata, Pitta and Kapha doshas balanced, possessing antiseptic, antacid and aphrodisiac properties, acts as a nutritive tonic, strengthens the body and mind. 
 This Ayurvedic medicine is effective in GIT related problems. It is suitable to provide relief from pain in intestinal colic, useful in chronic dysentery, provides relief from abdominal cramps, helps to control loose motion and other symptoms. Also good to use in sprue providing relief from weakness and aids in rapid recovery and even beneficial in Ulcerative Colitis. It improves the digestion also and helps in reducing the ulcers in oral cavity caused in stomatitis. It is useful remedy for respiratory conditions as in chronic bronchial diseases, reduces inflammation and improves the breathing to normal tone and beneficial in asthma, dilates the airway passage and ease in breathing and also suitable in tuberculosis too.  Indications

 Dose
